body:
What follows the first Linux deployable from the Build tab: the work set aside from the Build tab rollout milestone so it could stay at the minimum.

- What a build may reach: its permissions and network access.
- One approved version across every manifest.
- Turning a failed build into a task.
- Release notes, release history and package inspection.
- Cross-platform targets.
title: [Delivery Page] Build tab: after the first deployable
